info.title: WaseNet Public Document Authentication API
info.description: WaseNet Document Authentication Prototype Backend for Public Offices in Ethiopia (SRS-TC-2026-V1.1)

post.description:
Registers a new user account (FR-1.1).
Administrator accounts are registered in 'pending' status until approved by an active administrator.

Signs in a user and returns an 8-hour signed session JWT (FR-1.1, FR-1.3).
Rejects pending or disabled accounts with the exact same generic error as invalid credentials.
Rate limited per client IP and per username.

Logs out the user session (FR-1.3).
Stateless JWT logout acknowledgment.

get.description: Returns current authenticated user profile and roles (FR-1.3).

Exposes the latest public key bundle for the offline verifier PWA (FR-4.1).
Serves Active and Expired public keys only. Revoked keys and private material are strictly excluded.

Serves Document Revocation List (DRL) delta updates since a given version (FR-4.2).
Allows offline verifiers to synchronize only newly revoked records.

parameters.name: since

schema.description: Last known DRL version by client
schema.title: Since

parameters.description: Last known DRL version by client

post.description:
Revokes a document credential with a standardized reason code (FR-4.4).
Acquires an exclusive row lock (FOR UPDATE) on drl_state to guarantee monotonic,
collision-free version counter increments within a single atomic transaction.

Accepts batches of verification events from verifier apps (FR-5.1, FR-5.2).
Enforces idempotency using (client_event_id, device_id) deduplication key.
Retries will never create duplicate audit entries.
Rate limited per device_id.

Creates and digitally signs a new document credential (FR-2.1 to FR-2.4).
1. Canonicalizes structured payload (deterministic RFC 8785 JSON).
2. Computes SHA-256 digest.
3. Signs payload using ES256 (P-256 / SHA-256) with active key.
4. Encrypts holder national ID with AES-256-GCM.
5. Stores records atomically in a single database transaction.
6. Returns complete record and compact JWS QR payload.

post.description:
Synchronizes documents created while offline in batches (FR-2.5).
Sync is strictly idempotent by Document ID.
Repeated sync calls for existing document IDs change nothing and report 'already_synced'.

Audit log queries (FR-5.1, Scope 6).
Choice resolution:
- Administrators can query all verification events across Ethiopia.
- Issuers can query verification events specifically referencing documents created by their organization.
Lists all registered public keys with status (Active, Expired, Revoked).

Registers a new public verification certificate (FR-4.3).
Strictly forbids private key components.

Increments key bundle state counter atomically.

post.description:
Submits a document fraud report from the public website (FR-R1).
- Rate limited per IP address.
- Encrypts optional contact details at the application layer with AES-256-GCM.
- Generates unique tracking reference (FR-XXXXXXXX).
- Dispatches to INSA connector interface (stubbed in prototype).

patch.description: Updates investigation status of a fraud report (new, reviewing, closed).

Liveness probe.

Readiness probe.
Actively checks the PostgreSQL database connection (SELECT 1).
Returns 503 Service Unavailable if database is unreachable.
